newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Media Asia receives winding-up action.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Media Asia receives winding-up action.

text.p: Media Asia Pacific Ltd said on Wednesday the Australian Taxation Office (ATO) had lodged a winding up action against the company over outstanding debts to the tax office of A$203,394.
Media Asia said a separate winding up action against the company had been made by a former director of the company, Peter Adelstein, who claimed the groups owes him A$10,000.

It said both outstanding debts would be paid. It said Adelstein debt would be paid on February 21, and would be funded out of working capital, while the ATO would be paid by February 26 through the issue of new shares.
Media Asia said share issues has been approved by shareholders.
At 2.40 p.m. (0440 GMT), Media Asia shares were steady at 15 cents giving a market capitalisation of A$8.20 million.
